definitions.runtime_blind: No target answer artifact or answer-derived lookup is read while producing predictions.
definitions.provenance_blind: No coefficient or rule used by prediction was fitted or selected from the target answers.

verdict: The current normal-form machinery is a strong structural compression of the 864 simple-family signs, but it is not an independent no-answer-table derivation.
required_next_certificate: derive seed coefficients from the E6/Heisenberg bracket rather than the target sign table
derive the delta law algebraically rather than fitting it
enumerate the simple-family domain structurally without reading target keys
freeze a prediction hash before opening ce2_sparse_local_solutions.json
compare only after the prediction is frozen
boundary: This does not refute correctness of the existing predictor on its dataset; it refutes only the stronger answer-independent-derivation claim.
